result.label: C1_reference
result.pitch_convention: reported pitch is PHYSICAL nose-up-positive = -(gz/quat_rpy Euler pitch); raw_series 'pitch' field is the raw gz/quat_rpy value (nose-down-positive)

force_balance.net_My_note: net_My = My_aero(mirror) + dz*T_total, dz=0.0271 m; fwd thrust above CG => nose-down dz*T; ~0 at pitch trim

flight_path.note: steady climb angle gamma = asin(world_vz/V) should equal (pitch_phys - alpha); and T-D should equal W*sin(gamma). Both are independent self-consistency checks on the equilibrium.
